summary: Build practical skills in recruitment, onboarding, performance, and employee relations. Explore this five-day foundation course.
lede: Human resources management organizes how workplaces recruit, support, and develop employees. This foundation-level training is for HR staff and line managers who handle hiring, onboarding, performance, and employee concerns, with practical exercises in job analysis, structured interview scoring, and performance documentation. It also covers employee case handling and learning evaluation, with draft templates and process maps to adapt to workplace policies.
audienceIntro: This course suits you if you carry out or oversee everyday people processes and need a practical foundation for making them more consistent. It also supports line managers who handle hiring, performance conversations, onboarding, or employee concerns alongside their operational responsibilities.
modules: CIPD Profession Map and HR Roles
Employee Relations and HR Service Delivery
prerequisites: No formal HR qualification is required. Familiarity with workplace roles, manager responsibilities, or employee processes will help you connect the exercises to your work. No coding or programming is required.
